question: Should ai& be accepted as a built-in CodexBar provider once successful funded-account proof is supplied?
rationale: The implementation follows existing architecture, but accepting another permanently maintained provider is a product-scope choice that code review cannot settle.

options.title: Sponsor After Proof
options.body: Accept the provider direction, require redacted successful retrieval and rendering proof, and remove the PR-authored changelog entry before merge.

options.title: Defer Built-In Support
options.body: Pause the PR until usage demand or a repository-wide provider acceptance policy establishes sufficient maintenance value.

options.title: Decline the Provider
options.body: Close the PR if ai& does not meet the repository owner's threshold for another built-in provider surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor After Proof
recommendation.body: Accept the provider direction, require redacted successful retrieval and rendering proof, and remove the PR-authored changelog entry before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, steipete is the clearest available owner for accepting the long-term built-in provider commitment.
